description.value: Legends Whistler is a condominium-style slopeside lodge at Whistler Creekside, offering 1-3 bedroom suites with full kitchens just steps from the Creekside Gondola. Several suites overlook the Dave Murray ski run, site of the 2010 Winter Olympic Alpine events. The property is part of a small group of three Creekside hotels and caters primarily to families and groups seeking spacious self-catering accommodation.
